# Fresh integrated P6 installed-publication review

## Findings

No material findings in the bounded installed-contract/publication-contract package. Recommendation: **PASS for host installation qualification publication only**. Root owns acceptance; this recommendation does not accept full P6, production closure, current-state rehearsal or runtime activation.

This fresh read-only review used the candidate checkout only, with explicit command working directories. No application runtime imports, tests, builds, installs, network, operator/state operations, candidate writes, recursive agents or protected-original access occurred. The sole authored output is this report. Read AGENTS.md and all three .agent rules, both task contracts and review contract, baseline, gate analysis, actual four publication files, relevant plan sections7–10, P6-A boundaries and P5 rollback/reference-instance runbook. Applied the orchestrate-development fresh-review/verification rules for capacity-forced reduced isolation and cross-boundary installed-publication provenance. No new architectural decision was required.

## Acceptance coverage

**AC1 — covered for macOS arm64/Python3.13.2 core+api+dev only.** Raw create-env/pip-version/acquisition/freeze records bind new environment and public PyPI wheel-only acquisition separately from offline checks. Literal isolated pip argv, sanitized environment and privacy profile are retained. Acquisition exits0 and uses `download --only-binary=:all: --index-url https://pypi.org/simple` against the accepted local wheel with `[api,dev]`, not dependency sdists. Independently checked all114 wheel file hashes/sizes/0400 modes, exact wheelhouse membership, each full METADATA against the retained freeze, and all114 requirement lines against the freeze. Requirements hash is `c0232f91228f055db3c89d9318684a182a0ae9712e9a7e3cec8a18302daaf589`. This is platform-resolved host qualification, not all-extras/channel or production reproducibility.

**AC2 — covered for the same host/subset.** Accepted wheel input is SHA256 `3c72e14e4358f33368904c9bad138c4c301889a70b7acaf3d12665df17fb26ff`, archive `fa582770bac7d9dd328558082f874ccefdf6eb1d5a069d51a8ea8194b85c4378`, manifest `2a7a25356f9f8ef6de52eaa40ce4e10ac2f04f773f5cc1c2d60b45b1ddadcdd2`. Raw offline install uses `--no-index --require-hashes --find-links` and exits0 under network denial; worker and separately retained root pip checks exit0 with no broken requirements. Installed probe records115 distributions, site-packages roots/files/direct-url provenance and isolated external-cwd origins, with no editable direct URLs or frozen/source sys.path. I independently compared all1274 installed package members to the accepted wheel: zero mismatches/symlinks. All687 wheel package members also present in frozen source match it; the built frontend additions remain qualified by preserved P6-A build evidence rather than invented source equivalence. Independently compared all1865 manifest source members to archive and disposable frozen typing source: zero mismatches. Metadata/entrypoint/version binding remains0.3.0; guard/custom skills/scripts/frontend bytes remain intact.

**AC3 — covered for no-effect imports/help and negative startup only.** Raw installed probe imports nanobot, agent.loop, config.schema, cli.entry, api.server and crawler.worker from fresh site-packages, inventories17 manifests,10 extras and16 skills, and explicitly reports missing Crawl4AI worker runtime. Public channel inventory deliberately projects selected manifest fields; full raw manifests remain retained, including dependency declarations. No packaged channel inventory is treated as enablement or dependency closure. Five help commands exit0. Four actual unmodified foreground gateway/agent/serve/webui commands exit1 with MigrationIncompleteError and absent disposable negative state root. Ordinary profiles deny network/process-fork/non-allowlisted exec and home reads, with exact ancestor metadata and private bundle allowances. Typing uses its separately recorded finite interpreter/node execution profile. Root byte/pip rechecks use separately retained, narrower credential/state exclusions, not falsely presented as identical full-home application profiles. No positive service startup, loader qualification or guard bypass is claimed.

**AC4 — diagnostic completion covered; strict result FAIL.** Retained literal BasedPyright command is `env/bin/basedpyright --pythonpath env/bin/python --outputjson`, from disposable byte-identical frozen source with unchanged strict pyproject and declared isolated dev tool. Independently parsed the raw output:463 files,7420 diagnostics/errors,0 warnings/information, exit1; exactly56 reportMissingImports and7364 other diagnostics. Published rule/package counts and interpretation agree. Missing optional/channel environments can cause cascades, but publication does not dismiss all other diagnostics or claim full all-extras CI PASS. No source repair/import silencing/config weakening occurred.

The separately authorized DOCX extension is correctly bounded: worker and root retained exact one-node outcomes each show1 passed, independently and never summed. Actual test/root conftest/pyproject bytes match frozen source and current unchanged candidate. Installed `set_config_path` only assigns the explicit disposable instance path, avoiding default-home upload state without Config/load_config/config creation/HOME reassignment or fixture/app/assertion changes. Isolated `-I` installed origins/no-source paths are recorded before/after pytest. Separate localhost-only profile and socket probe bind127.0.0.1 while rejecting1.1.1.1:443. This qualifies a mock-agent fixture listener only, not real service or actual operator init-only loader policy.

**AC5 — covered for scoped evidence/publication.** Independently verified all55 durable retained evidence records' exact hashes/sizes/0400 modes against the actual public JSON, plus retained closure wheels/requirements. Literal commands, environments, profiles, raw outputs, helpers/contracts/gate analysis and root records are bound. Red sandbox parser/launcher/initial helper expectation/DOCX home-denial outcomes remain red with their actual nonzero exits; no retroactive green or summation. Current artifacts preserve root failed launcher and qualified checks separately. Full P6, runtime/D9, background and later-stage limits are explicit. Publication remains pending root/fresh review as required rather than self-accepted.

## Scope and publication integration

Independently hashed all1866 root-baseline files: only existing rehearsal and handoff changed. The complete rehearsal historical prefix is byte-identical to rehearsal-before.md. ## Gaps and residual gates

No missing evidence prevents this bounded publication recommendation. I did not rerun application checks by design; root independently owns rerun evidence and final acceptance. Read-only metadata/hash inspection cannot establish universal absence of every possible side effect; claims appropriately rely on retained OS profiles, literal commands, raw denied attempts and scope checks, not a live-operation claim.

No synthetic operator/state rehearsal occurred. Current legacy parsing is not old-release-reader equivalence, DOCX explicit instance binding is not operator-loader qualification, and guard-negative startup is not positive runtime admission. Runtime NOT_READY/NOT_AUTHORIZED, D9 NOT_AUTHORIZED, P7/H1/P8 NOT_DELIVERED and background work off remain unchanged. P6 completion, when separately achieved, would still not authorize P7/D9/canary or guard removal.

## Recommendation

**PASS — bounded host installed qualification and four-document publication, subject to root final acceptance.** No corrective source/document request. **NOT_ACCEPTED — full P6/production release; NOT_AUTHORIZED — runtime/D9/live activation.**
